scope_clarification.authority: Direct author answer to pending HELDOUT question
scope_clarification.author_verbatim: 这是对 V2 中'not in any training or retrieval bank'的澄清，不是改动：指本研究自己的再训练集和检索库。不保证公开 LeWM checkpoint 及 M01/M07 作者训练时未见过这些 episode；LeWM 官方协议本身从训练数据集中抽取评测窗口，主研究的 case 同样如此，因此 HELDOUT 与主研究同分布。HELDOUT 用于防止本研究的分析选择过拟合，不用于检验对未见 episode 的泛化。
scope_clarification.scope: Exclude all R3-R10/D1 case sets, own refit training sets, and AP retrieval bank; all evaluation episodes including HELDOUT excluded from rebuilt AP bank
